messages: October 7 premarket market tables populated from verified observations at or before the 09:20 ET cutoff. Quote collection completed at 11:29 AM PT; the separate scanner remains a draft without a captured stock universe.
Robinhood supplied SPY and QQQ actual extended-hours 1-minute bars in the 04:00–09:20 ET window; each has a valid 09:19 bar. Their prior closes are official SIP closes from October 6.
TradingView supplied timestamped VIX, NQ/ES futures, and Treasury-yield bars. TradingView warns that data can be delayed 15+ minutes; observation and retrieval timestamps are stored per row.

ES and NQ key-level ranges contain all 920 expected one-minute bars from 18:00 ET October 6 through 09:19 ET October 7. YM and RTY remain blank: TradingView did not return usable timestamped bars, and retries failed with a WebSocket handshake error. No proxy was substituted.

The VIX value uses its last available bar at 09:18 ET; the 2Y yield also uses 09:18 ET. The 5Y, 10Y, 30Y, SPY, QQQ, NQ, and ES values use 09:19 ET bars. TradingView's prior-session yield references use each tenor's last available bar before 17:00 ET October 6.

Public.com returned UNKNOWN for the Treasury symbols tested; it was not used. The Treasury table is sourced from TradingView. Macro-calendar items remain carried forward from the October 5 source check.

indices.title: Equity Commentary
indices.body:
Oil is trading at around $90, hovering around that 88 technical level. Oil and bond yields will still prove to be strong headwinds against equities.

Both indices made new ATHs yesterday, with a strong fade into 2nd half of the session and follow through selling overnight. Bitcoin is following through on a strong down move in Asia session.

That being said, breadth still remains weak and we are trading into earnings/midterms which only means additional volatility is on the horizon. I get the sense the market will range here until things change. Neither bulls nor bears want to be offsides if Trump strikes a deal with Iran.

bonds.title: Bond Commentary
bonds.body:
France's national debt is still a point of concern - small cooldown to 4.9% overnight, still elevated.

US Treasury 10Y made a new high overnight, sitting around 5.337%.
